[vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1436877382226{margin-bottom: 15px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_column_text css=””]Elevate your expertise in facial aesthetics with the International Fellowship in Facial Aesthetics offered by Dentomax International Academy. This comprehensive 10-day program is designed for dental professionals and medical practitioners looking to expand their skills in non-surgical cosmetic procedures and gain hands-on experience in the rapidly growing field of facial aesthetics.

Key Highlights:

  • Duration: 6 Months

10 days of intensive Hands-On training.

  • Comprehensive Curriculum: Learn the latest techniques in facial aesthetics, including Botox, dermal fillers, facial contouring, and skin rejuvenation.
  • Hands-on Training: Gain practical, hands-on experience with live demonstrations and supervised sessions, ensuring you are confident in your abilities.
  • Experienced Faculty: Taught by renowned professionals with experience in the field, providing personalized guidance and expert insights.
  • State-of-the-Art Facilities: Train in cutting-edge facilities with the latest technology to ensure a real-world learning experience.
  • Certification: Upon successful completion, receive a fellowship certification that adds significant value to your professional credentials.

Dentomax International Academy recognizes the profound impact that Facial Aesthetics can have on the lives of both practitioners and clients. Our Fellowship in Facial Aesthetics is a testament to our commitment to providing professionals with the knowledge and skills needed to navigate this dynamic field with expertise and confidence.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435574544208{margin-bottom: 8px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text=”Main Features:” font_container=”tag:h4|text_align:left” google_fonts=”font_family:Montserrat%3Aregular%2C700|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435305038672{margin-bottom: 30px !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_column_text]

  • Comprehensive Curriculum:

Immerse yourself in a one-year program divided into 6 modules, covering the spectrum of theoretical foundations and practical applications in Facial Aesthetics.

  • In-depth Understanding:

Explore facial anatomy, physiology, and the intricate aspects of aesthetic interventions, gaining a comprehensive understanding of the field.

  • Practical Training:

Acquire hands-on experience through practical sessions, refining your skills in administering a range of aesthetic treatments.

  • Expert Guidance:

Learn from experienced professionals and experts who bring real-world insights to the learning experience.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_column_text]

  • Business Insights:

Delve into the business side of Facial Aesthetics, understanding practice management, ethical considerations, and strategies for establishing a successful career.

  • Objective Evaluation:

Demonstrate your understanding through an objective exam, earning a Certification that validates your proficiency in Facial Aesthetics.

  • Internship Opportunities:

Benefit from internship support, and gain practical exposure under professional supervision to enhance your clinical skills.

  • Placement Assistance:

Avail our placement support system, connecting you with potential employers and facilitating the transition from education to a rewarding career in Facial Aesthetics.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435574551925{margin-bottom: 8px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text=”Course Description:” font_container=”tag:h4|text_align:left” google_fonts=”font_family:Montserrat%3Aregular%2C700|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=””]The Dentomax International Academy’s International Fellowship in Facial Aesthetics is a transformative journey designed to equip professionals with a nuanced understanding of the art and science of facial enhancement. 

Over one year and six comprehensive modules, participants delve into facial anatomy, physiology, and practical applications of aesthetic interventions. Our commitment to providing a well-rounded education includes hands-on training, expert guidance, and insights into the business aspects of Facial Aesthetics. 

Participants undergo an objective evaluation to showcase their proficiency, culminating in the award of a Certification. With internship opportunities and placement assistance, the Fellowship sets the stage for a successful career in the dynamic and rewarding field of Facial Aesthetics.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435574600454{margin-bottom: 17px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_column_text]

  • The main objective to the sketching process is to generate super rough thumbnail sketches of what we feel best visually communicates the highlighted words from our mind maps.
  • Take as much time as you need for this step — this might be 10 minutes or it might be 10 days.
  • Personally, I like to work quickly and try not to analyze or elaborate too much.
  • Now, that doesn’t mean you should only create a handful of sketches.

contentHtml:
[vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1436877382226{margin-bottom: 15px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_column_text]Elevate your dental practice to new aesthetic heights with the Certification in Aesthetic Dentistry offered by Dentomax International Academy. 

This specialized certification program is tailored for dental professionals seeking comprehensive knowledge and hands-on skills in aesthetic dentistry. 

Over four days of intensive training, participants will explore the art and science of creating beautiful smiles through evidence-based aesthetic dental procedures.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435574544208{margin-bottom: 8px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text=”Main Features:” font_container=”tag:h4|text_align:left” google_fonts=”font_family:Montserrat%3Aregular%2C700|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435305038672{margin-bottom: 30px !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_column_text]

  • Smile Design Principles:

Learn the principles of smile design, including facial and dental analysis, to create harmonious and aesthetically pleasing smiles.

  • Composite Bonding Techniques:

Master the art of composite bonding for direct restorations, addressing issues like discoloration, chipping, or minor misalignments.

  • Porcelain Veneers Application:

Gain proficiency in the application of porcelain veneers, a transformative technique for enhancing the shape, color, and alignment of teeth.

  • Teeth Whitening Protocols:

Understand the various teeth whitening protocols, including in-office and take-home options, to achieve optimal and safe results.

  • Gingival Contouring:

Explore gingival contouring techniques to enhance the symmetry and balance of the gingival architecture, complementing aesthetic dental treatments.

  • Case Selection and Treatment Planning:

Develop skills in case selection and treatment planning, considering individual patient characteristics and expectations.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_column_text]

  • Hands-On Practical Sessions:

Engage in hands-on practical sessions, allowing participants to apply aesthetic dentistry techniques under the guidance of experienced faculty.

  • Posterior Aesthetics:

Explore techniques for achieving posterior aesthetics, addressing challenges related to restoring molars and premolars.

  • Interactive Case Discussions:

Participate in interactive case discussions, where participants can share insights, discuss challenges, and learn from real-world cases presented by faculty and peers.

  • Patient Communication Skills:

Enhance communication skills for effectively discussing aesthetic options with patients, managing expectations, and obtaining informed consent.

  • Practice Integration:

Receive guidance on integrating aesthetic dentistry into daily practice, including marketing strategies and patient education.

  • Certification Examination:

Conclude the program with a certification examination, evaluating participants’ understanding and practical proficiency in aesthetic dentistry principles and techniques.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435574551925{margin-bottom: 8px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text=”Course Description:” font_container=”tag:h4|text_align:left” google_fonts=”font_family:Montserrat%3Aregular%2C700|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]The Dentomax International Academy Certification in Aesthetic Dentistry is a transformative program designed for dental professionals aspiring to excel in the field of aesthetic dentistry. 

Participants will acquire comprehensive knowledge and hands-on skills through a curriculum focused on smile design, composite bonding, veneers, whitening, and more. 

The program concludes with a certification examination, recognizing participants’ readiness to provide exceptional aesthetic dental care.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435574600454{margin-bottom: 17px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_column_text]

  • Introduction to digital smile design tools and techniques.
  • Incorporating technology for precise treatment planning.

[/stm_course_lesson][stm_course_lesson icon=”fa-icon-stm_icon_book” badge=”lecture” title=”Aesthetic Materials and Technology”]

  • Overview of aesthetic dental materials.
  • Incorporating the latest technology in aesthetic dentistry.

[/stm_course_lesson][stm_course_lesson icon=”fa-icon-stm_icon_book” badge=”lecture” title=”Complications and Risk Management”]

  • Strategies for risk mitigation in aesthetic procedures.

[/stm_course_lesson][stm_course_lesson icon=”fa-icon-stm_icon_book” badge=”lecture” title=”Practice Management in Aesthetic Dentistry”]

  • Integrating aesthetic dentistry into a dental practice.

[/stm_course_lesson][stm_course_lesson icon=”rtl_demo-teacher” badge=”practice” title=”Case Studies and Review”]

  • Analyzing successful aesthetic cases.
  • Learning from challenging cases for continuous improvement.

[vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1436877382226{margin-bottom: 15px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_column_text]In a world where first impressions are increasingly significant, Facial Aesthetics stands at the forefront of transforming not just appearances but also the confidence and self-esteem of individuals. 

The importance of mastering the art and science of Facial Aesthetics lies in its ability to merge medical precision with artistic finesse, offering individuals the opportunity to enhance their natural beauty. 

Dentomax International Academy recognizes the profound impact that Facial Aesthetics can have on the lives of both practitioners and clients. Our Fellowship in Facial Aesthetics is a testament to our commitment to providing professionals with the knowledge and skills needed to navigate this dynamic field with expertise and confidence.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435574544208{margin-bottom: 8px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text=”Main Features:” font_container=”tag:h4|text_align:left” google_fonts=”font_family:Montserrat%3Aregular%2C700|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435305038672{margin-bottom: 30px !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_column_text]

  • Comprehensive Curriculum:

Immerse yourself in a one-year program divided into 6 modules, covering the spectrum of theoretical foundations and practical applications in Facial Aesthetics.

  • In-depth Understanding:

Explore facial anatomy, physiology, and the intricate aspects of aesthetic interventions, gaining a comprehensive understanding of the field.

  • Practical Training:

Acquire hands-on experience through practical sessions, refining your skills in administering a range of aesthetic treatments.

  • Expert Guidance:

Learn from experienced professionals and experts who bring real-world insights to the learning experience.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_column_text]

  • Business Insights:

Delve into the business side of Facial Aesthetics, understanding practice management, ethical considerations, and strategies for establishing a successful career.

  • Objective Evaluation:

Demonstrate your understanding through an objective exam, earning a Certification that validates your proficiency in Facial Aesthetics.

  • Internship Opportunities:

Benefit from internship support, and gain practical exposure under professional supervision to enhance your clinical skills.

  • Placement Assistance:

Avail our placement support system, connecting you with potential employers and facilitating the transition from education to a rewarding career in Facial Aesthetics.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435574551925{margin-bottom: 8px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text=”Course Description:” font_container=”tag:h4|text_align:left” google_fonts=”font_family:Montserrat%3Aregular%2C700|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]The Dentomax International Academy Fellowship in Facial Aesthetics is a transformative journey designed to equip professionals with a nuanced understanding of the art and science of facial enhancement. 

Over the course of one year and six comprehensive modules, participants delve into facial anatomy, physiology, and practical applications of aesthetic interventions. Our commitment to providing a well-rounded education includes hands-on training, expert guidance, and insights into the business aspects of Facial Aesthetics. 

Participants undergo an objective evaluation to showcase their proficiency, culminating in the award of a Certification. With internship opportunities and placement assistance, the Fellowship sets the stage for a successful career in the dynamic and rewarding field of Facial Aesthetics.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1435574600454{margin-bottom: 17px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Engage in practical sessions to hone your skills in performing various cosmetic procedures, ensuring immediate applicability.

Immerse yourself in a comprehensive two-year program that covers advanced theories and practical applications in non-medical cosmetology.

Gain advanced knowledge and expertise in a range of non-invasive cosmetic procedures, including the latest innovations in skincare and beauty enhancement.

  • Research Component:

Engage in research projects and case studies, deepening your understanding of cosmetology and contributing to the advancement of the field.

  • Practical Mastery:

Hone your skills through extensive hands-on experience, mastering advanced techniques in skincare, makeup application, and beauty enhancement.

Learn from distinguished professionals and industry experts who provide mentorship and share valuable insights from their experiences.

Avail our placement support system, facilitating connections with potential employers and ensuring a smooth transition to a successful career in cosmetology.

Explore and analyze advanced cosmetic products, understanding their formulations, applications, and suitability for diverse skin types.

  • Advanced Trend Analysis:

Stay at the forefront of industry trends, analyzing and incorporating the latest advancements and innovations in non-medical cosmetology.

Undertake a master’s thesis project, showcasing your mastery of a specific aspect of cosmetology and contributing to the academic discourse in the field.

fullPublicText: Embark on a profound journey into the world of non-medical cosmetology with the Master of Science (MSc) in Cosmetology (Non-Medical) at Dentomax International Academy. This two-year program is meticulously crafted to delve into the depths of cosmetic procedures, encompassing skincare, makeup application, and advanced beauty enhancement techniques. The MSc in Cosmetology (Non-Medical) offers a comprehensive blend of theoretical knowledge and practical expertise, empowering professionals to excel in the dynamic and evolving field of non-medical cosmetology. In-depth Exploration : Immerse yourself in a comprehensive two-year program that covers advanced theories and practical applications in non-medical cosmetology. Advanced Knowledge : Gain advanced knowledge and expertise in a range of non-invasive cosmetic procedures, including the latest innovations in skincare and beauty enhancement. Research Component : Engage in research projects and case studies, deepening your understanding of cosmetology and contributing to the advancement of the field. Practical Mastery : Hone your skills through extensive hands-on experience, mastering advanced techniques in skincare, makeup application, and beauty enhancement. Expert Faculty : Learn from distinguished professionals and industry experts who provide mentorship and share valuable insights from their experiences. Business Integration : Acquire advanced business acumen, including strategic planning, marketing, and practice management in the field of cosmetology. Internship Opportunities : Benefit from internship support, and gain practical exposure under professional supervision to enhance your clinical skills. Placement Assistance : Avail our placement support system, facilitating connections with potential employers and ensuring a smooth transition to a successful career in cosmetology. Specialized Electives: Choose from a variety of specialized electives, allowing you to tailor your academic journey to your specific interests within the field of cosmetology. Advanced Product Knowledge: Explore and analyze advanced cosmetic products, understanding their formulations, applications, and suitability for diverse skin types. Advanced Trend Analysis: Stay at the forefront of industry trends, analyzing and incorporating the latest advancements and innovations in non-medical cosmetology. Master’s Thesis: Undertake a master’s thesis project, showcasing your mastery of a specific aspect of cosmetology and contributing to the academic discourse in the field. International Recognition: Attain a globally recognized Master of Science degree in Cosmetology (Non-Medical), opening doors to international opportunities in the cosmetic industry. The Dentomax International Academy Master of Science (MSc) in Cosmetology (Non-Medical) is a transformative two-year program designed for professionals seeking an in-depth exploration of non-invasive cosmetic procedures. The inclusion of internships, placement assistance, and a research component ensures a well-rounded education and prepares participants for leadership roles in the field. fullPublicText: Embark on a transformative journey in the field of medical aesthetics with the Certification in Injectables at Dentomax International Academy. This specialized certification program is tailored for healthcare professionals seeking expertise in administering injectable treatments. Over the span of this comprehensive certification, participants will delve into the art and science of injectables, mastering the techniques and safety protocols associated with cosmetic injectable procedures. Focused Curriculum : Engage in a focused curriculum that covers the principles, techniques, and safety considerations associated with administering injectable treatments. Anatomy and Physiology : Develop a deep understanding of facial anatomy and physiology, crucial for precision and safety in injectable procedures. Neuromodulators and Dermal Fillers : Learn the intricacies of neuromodulators and dermal fillers, including their properties, indications, and appropriate injection techniques. Hands-On Training : Gain practical experience through hands-on training sessions, allowing participants to apply theoretical knowledge in a supervised environment. Patient Assessment : Enhance skills in patient assessment, consultation, and individualized treatment planning to achieve optimal aesthetic outcomes. Safety Protocols : Emphasize safety protocols, adverse event management, and ethical considerations in the administration of injectable treatments. Advanced Techniques : Explore advanced injection techniques for various facial areas, ensuring participants can address a range of aesthetic concerns with precision. Patient-Centered Approach : Foster a patient-centered approach, emphasizing effective communication, informed consent, and post-treatment care. Live Demonstrations: Witness live demonstrations by experienced practitioners, providing insights into best practices and nuances of injectable procedures. Interactive Workshops: Participate in interactive workshops, allowing for peer-to-peer learning, Q&A sessions, and collaborative discussions. Product Knowledge: Acquire in-depth knowledge of injectable products, including their formulations, uses, and best practices for achieving natural-looking results. Legal and Regulatory Compliance: Understand the legal and regulatory aspects related to administering injectable treatments, ensuring participants practice within ethical and legal boundaries. Certification Exam: Conclude the program with a comprehensive certification exam, assessing participants’ understanding of injectable procedures and safety measures.
